name: Necromancer bench: Command: Ghouls lets a commanded kill give experience with no swing
contract: SoloKill.RequirePlayerHit (#10365) gives an ungrouped player experience from a creature only if the player registered a hit on it. Order() (AscensionNecromancerSummons.cpp:405) drives the minion but may not register that hit. Raise: Ghoul 500971 (cost 1 Life Force, no Life Force talent needed) summons creature 50073; Command: Ghouls 504021 is plain trainer-learnable (SkillLineAbility 23148, no talent gate). The Necromancer raises one Ghoul, orders Command: Ghouls at a creature, never swings, and the Ghoul alone kills it. This bench checks whether the necromancer still gains experience from that kill.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and the Life Force aura settle
Let the Ghoul take its formation place and the global cooldown pass
Select the creature so Order() finds it through GetTarget() (504021's own effect targets the caster)
SETUP: the Command cast went through
SETUP: the Ghoul kills the creature
BENCH: the commanded kill gives experience
BENCH: the experience did not cross a level
